enrichment_method.evidence: For global phosphopeptide analysis, desalted peptides were enriched with titanium dioxide (TiO2) beads, using aliphatic hydroxy-acid modified metal oxide chromatography (MOAC).

For specific enrichment of phosphotyrosine (pTyr)-containing peptides, lyophilized peptides were dissolved in 700 μl immunoprecipitation buffer (20 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.2, 10 mM sodium phosphate, 50 mM NaCl) and transferred at 4ºC to a tube containing 20 μl of a 50% (v/v) slurry of agarose beads harboring P-Tyr-1000 anti-phosphotyrosine monoclonal antibodies (Cell Signaling Technologies, 8803).

labeling.evidence: inferred: Phosphopeptides and phosphosites were quantified from the area under the curve of the MS1 signal of each eluting peptide (‘Intensity’ in MaxQuant).
